credential.source: static replay -- no server, and no API key is published with a static site

versions.name: v0-naive
versions.headline: One-shot prompt. No policy, no schema, evidence dumped in.
versions.hypothesis: Establishes the floor. A capable model with the documents but no written policy has to invent the tolerances, and will not agree with the Controller's Office about what they are.

versions.name: v1-baseline
versions.headline: Fair baseline: full policy in context, strict output schema, all evidence inlined, single call, no tools.
versions.hypothesis: Removes format failures and gives the model the actual rules. This is the strongest thing you can build without agent scaffolding, so it is what the agent must beat to have proved anything.

versions.name: v2-tools
versions.headline: + deterministic calculators (UOM, tolerance, quantity, tax, FX, credits, thresholds).
versions.hypothesis: Largest expected single gain. The arithmetic leaves the model. Amount accuracy should move much more than disposition accuracy -- if both move equally, something other than arithmetic was fixed and the claim is wrong.

versions.name: v3-evidence
versions.headline: + evidence retrieval instead of a context dump, with mandatory citation.
versions.hypothesis: Cases 005 and 009 turn on one line in an email or a contract that is easy to skim past when it arrives inside a wall of inlined text. Forcing a deliberate read, and a citation, should fix them.

versions.name: v4-verifier
versions.headline: + independent verifier pass that re-derives the arithmetic and can veto an unreconciled approval.
versions.hypothesis: Targets the false-approval rate specifically -- the error that costs money. Expected to cost tokens and latency for little accuracy gain.

versions.name: v5-memory
versions.headline: + vendor memory carried across the queue.
versions.hypothesis: A queue is not a set of independent cases. Facts established on an earlier invoice -- this vendor bills a monthly retainer, this buyer authorised a surcharge -- should carry forward. Risk: a fact that was true for one PO gets applied to another where it is not.

versions.name: v6-enforce
versions.headline: + the harness rejects a verdict that cites nothing, or cites a file that does not exist, and asks once more.
versions.hypothesis: Citation validity should stop being a coin flip. Resolution accuracy should not move at all -- the re-ask only asks for provenance, never for a different answer. If accuracy does move, the check is doing something it was not supposed to do and must come out.

versions.name: vX-confidence
versions.headline: REMOVAL EXPERIMENT: model self-rates confidence and skips verification when it feels sure.
versions.hypothesis: Cheaper and probably no less accurate on aggregate -- and that is the trap. Self-rated confidence is expected to be highest exactly where the model is confidently wrong, so false approvals should rise even if accuracy does not fall.

versions.name: final
versions.headline: Shipping configuration: the survivors — policy, schema, calculators, retrieval, enforced citations. The verifier, the memory and the confidence field were measured and cut.
versions.hypothesis: v3's lever set plus the citation check that v3 showed was needed.
